scope: Current-turn QMD editorial diff against the requested before-copy; full-text context reviewed. No research or rendered-publication approval.

method.diff_basis: Explicit before-copy, not HEAD or older revision history
method.table_comparison: Exact headers, alignment lines, rows, captions and identifiers
method.citation_comparison: Ordered scholarly citation keys excluding figure/table/equation references
method.equation_comparison: Ordered display and inline math source strings
method.memory_classification: near_match_only; navigation hint, not manuscript or scientific authority

findings.topic: Abstract and introduction remove downstream construction goals
findings.finding: Prototype implementation purpose and thesis-to-ARGO-to-NAIS roadmap are removed, not renamed. Replacement text limits the thesis to literature-grounded design, comparison conditions and completed measurement checks.

findings.topic: Anonymous runtime substrate is not retained as a construction roadmap
findings.finding: Resident service, stateful interactive environment, session recovery and UI substrate description is removed. Remaining execution-support functions are defined as a conceptual role and information-transfer specification, with integrated satisfaction explicitly unverified.

findings.topic: Results limitations and conclusion remove private downstream plans
findings.finding: Hackathon prototype completion target and product design/implementation sequence are removed. The conclusion ends on the unmeasured research question and the limits of measurement evidence.

findings.topic: Scientific proposals remain expressly unmeasured and within the thesis question
findings.finding: Evidence representation, dependency updates, separate refinement histories and fair comparisons address the stated question. These are presented as design or evaluation proposals, not implemented guarantees or local efficacy results. Existing literature claims were not independently revalidated in this editorial review.

findings.topic: No completed H1/H2/H3 comparison or integrated implementation is claimed in context
findings.finding: Hypotheses are prospective; no efficacy-admitted runs, computed effect estimates or completed tests are asserted. The integrated runner row remains at zero validated tasks.

findings.topic: Reported 96 checks are not promoted to agent efficacy
findings.finding: The stated 16 tasks x (3 positive + 3 damaged-output repetitions) = 96 remains separate from agent-generated answers, independent task samples, the isolation check path and integrated efficacy. These reported checks were not rerun or re-certified by this review.

findings.topic: Concise captions preserve explanatory boundaries in QMD prose
findings.finding: Short captions replace long descriptions, while conceptual status, graph recheck semantics and the non-efficacy distinction of the two measurement paths remain in adjacent prose. SVG content and rendered correspondence are not reviewed.

nonblocking_notes.quote: 이 관측 결과를 새 실험의 과학적 타당성 전반과 동일시하지 않으며
nonblocking_notes.minimal_replacement: 향후 얻을 관측 결과를 새 실험의 과학적 타당성 전반과 동일시하지 않으며
nonblocking_notes.reason: The phrase can sound observed if excerpted alone. The same paragraph says subsequent evaluation, and nearby/global unmeasured statements prevent a completed-comparison reading in context. Not a new diff defect or MUST_FIX.

tables.rows_hash_serialization: UTF-8 pipe-table lines joined by LF, including one trailing LF; captions compared separately

pass_conditions: Applies only to the exact reviewed current QMD hash
Private product and hackathon roadmap is substantively removed from the manuscript
Scientific proposal is necessary to the thesis question and expressly unmeasured
Existing measurement checks do not imply efficacy, completed H1/H2/H3 or integrated implementation
Seven tables, thirteen scholarly citations, all math and the evidence cutoff remain preserved
conditions_requiring_re_review: Relevant QMD content changes after the reviewed hash
Root integration reintroduces private roadmap content, including anonymous equivalents
Figure or caption integration introduces completed-comparison or integrated-implementation claims
root_owned_not_reviewed: Concurrent SVG contents and figure-worker reports
Final figure text and accessibility/alternative-text metadata
One-column visual layout and every final PDF page geometry
